title: AI-71 Capability Error
description: Structured error block on a CapabilityResult. Categories are contract | policy | execution | internal; codes are the stable namespaced enumeration defined by the AI-71 contract. The schema rejects raw provider exception messages, stack traces, and vendor error codes.

details.description: Optional structured detail. The contract does not constrain the value shape beyond 'object'; validators may treat unknown shapes as opaque.
